headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) CFO Exit Looms, Does The Stock Look Fully Valued?
headlines.summary: Strategy (MSTR) is in focus after announcing that Chief Financial Officer Andrew Kang plans to resign on November 5, 2026. A staggered handover of finance leadership roles has already been mapped out. Recent trading shows that Strategy shares remain volatile, with a 1-day share price return of 5.09% and a 90-day share price return of 42.53%, even as the 30-day share price return is down 13.38% and the year-to-date share price return is down 9.30% at a last close of US$142.54.

headlines.title: Strategy's STRC hits par for first time since May.  This is why it matters
headlines.summary: Scott Melker breaks down Strategy's (MSTR) preferred stock, STRC (STRC), returning to its $100 par value for the first time since May. Melker examines what the milestone means for Michael Saylor's bitcoin (BTC-USD) accumulation strategy and what it could signal about investor confidence in bitcoin. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
